mapper.select: SELECT id, book_id, reader_id, borrow_time, due_time, return_time, status, is_overdue, is_deleted, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM borrow_record WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM borrow_record WHERE reader_id = #{readerId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status IN ('BORROWING', 'OVERDUE')
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM borrow_record WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status IN ('BORROWING', 'OVERDUE')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO borrow_record (book_id, reader_id, borrow_time, due_time, return_time, status, is_overdue, is_deleted) VALUES (#{bookId}, #{readerId}, #{borrowTime}, #{dueTime}, #{returnTime}, #{status}, #{isOverdue}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE borrow_record SET status = 'RETURNED', return_time = #{returnTime}, is_overdue = #{isOverdue}, gmt_modified = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status IN ('BORROWING', 'OVERDUE')
